Create Bonfire.todo: The bonfire is a one-shot save on cast only (whoever's standing there right now) — RAW's persistent hazard that re-triggers the save when a creature moves into it or ends its turn there isn't modeled (no damaging-terrain-hazard system exists yet, only movement-cost hazardCells and the owner-scoped MovementDamageHook). Concentration is tracked (so it still ends on the caster losing focus) but the bonfire itself does nothing after the initial cast.

Infestation.todo: The 'moves 5ft in a random d4-rolled direction on a failed save' clause isn't modeled — push/pull effects only move a target toward/away from the caster, there's no random-direction forced-movement primitive. Damage lands correctly; the shove doesn't happen.

Produce Flame.todo: 2024 PHB split this into a Bonus Action to conjure the flame (which then sheds Bright/Dim Light for the 10-minute duration) and a separate Action any time later to hurl it as this ranged spell attack. Only the attack half is modeled — actionCostOverride corrects the attack's cost to a full Action, but the flame can't be conjured (or shed light) without also immediately attacking with it, and there's no standalone light-source step like Light/Starry Wisp got.
